Save as REALWORLDPLAN.MD,  Add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oceanseth/InfiniteMirror/refs/heads/main/OPEN-SESSION-LICENSE.md to root of github and add reference to it within AGENTS.MD - I will begin to describe the project in brief, you will ask questions and create the GTM-PLAN.MD and DEVELOPMENT-PLAN.MD - this project is starting as a submission to the self evolving agent hackathon, learn about the sponsors, go DEEP to understand them and the ideal way to use them for the project we will describe shortly. We don't have to use them all, mainly we will be using actian for the vectordb knowledge base and guild.ai and senso, along with a replay.io that simulates usage of our app on a website and mobile. It will live as a landing vite page and a mobile app that we plan to submit to the app store shortly under the name LivingBook (the name of this repo). The core concept, bringing real author's books to life as talking videos they can embed on their website, built from masky. Authors should be able to login and manage their books, upload related content/documents/etc - we will bring an agent online to market the book based on real world signals trending on social media. For example, we can answer the question "what does the bible say about this lawsuit in the court today" and have a video of the characters or a narrator reading the relevant section of the bible. (add this example to the github README). users will be able to favorite books within the app, interact with the agents that represent those books. Authors can upload new books or assets to books - such as podcasts where they talked about it, transcripts of q&a with fans, and so on - so future people can ask their agent questions and the knowledge base can pull up exact word for word transcripts to answer the question as the author already has. It will not invtent new words except short prhases like 'I've answered this question before ... on this podcast/from this user/ etc, and I said '{transcript}'" - masky brings this to life with a voice or video experience depending on the users credits available on masky. The author earns a portion of the user credit spend, and users can easily reshare any of the small sections of the book or agent sessions to their socials. Also existing older books will be made available like the bible in a 'public domain' section within the app - the bible as our first example for this hackathon. Go ahead and setup the md files and begin asking me questions about the ecosystem. We want to build on top of masky and aws, use react-native for the mobile app.
